text: Plan: inspect the freshly populated board and rerun its baseline checks, then implement a 40 x 30 mm edge-connector layout using only move_footprint plus anchored outline/track/via/label edits. Record the actual routing and library-internal findings in docs/LAYOUT.md, update only stale stage-status text, and complete the original DRC/ERC/drift and finish gates. The earlier interrupted layout is historical only; current results must be regenerated. Connector access, bypass return loops, fault-current copper and unresolved physical qualification remain explicit risks.
